study.question: Does the observed substitutability of raw and scaled/gated target-match action summaries persist under a shared residual mapping, and does conditional feedback utility interact with task-index versus bank-mean readout?
study.hypothesis: The task-readout erasure factorial has both-versus-none click-AUC lift 0.002490768750 and raw x scaled cross difference -0.001659857685. Either match-action copy preserves most of the conditional lift. The weak preliminary prediction is that this redundancy persists under shared readout and task conditioning contributes mainly an additive advantage. Earlier shared endpoint and rotation receipts suggest no large interaction, but their source/optimizer bridges and numerical preflight are unverified. Completing the exact same source factorial at shared routing distinguishes stable substitution from an implementation-specific task interaction. This is a conditional mechanism study, without a new architecture or priority claim.

evidence_review.scope: Validation-only committed receipts. Numbers below are observations, not numerical correctness or causal-mechanism certification. No test feedback supplied or used.
multiple_trajectories: The strongest imported joint reference g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached remains better in click AUC (0.66675355) than the action-scorer-zero endpoint g1-r0025-action_value_task (0.66624443). This proposal seeks attribution, not a promised improvement.

The context-code action replacement g1-r0024-token_context_task scored 0.64142969 versus DIN 0.65554408. That unsuccessful replacement retained action-derived masks and unequal lookup usage/optimization, so it is not a clean all-feedback causal estimate.

r0030 match-only rotation is worse in both readouts (task 0.66373183; shared 0.66197468). r0031 rotating just raw or scaled rows largely preserves task utility (0.66600505/0.66587564); rotating both does not (0.66373183).

r0032 erasure likewise preserves most task utility with either row (raw 0.66590193/scaled 0.66575602) versus both (0.66624443) and neither (0.66375366). It agrees qualitatively with replacement redundancy, but all diagnostics are not_requested and only one seed is available.

r0029 aligned shared endpoint 0.66474880 and r0028 ordinal-only shared endpoint 0.66181604 suggest shared both-versus-none lift around 0.00293; these are descriptive because sources differ and exact optimizer bridges have not been certified.

g1-r0025-action_value_task, g1-r0029-summary_align_task, g1-r0031-align_match_task and g1-r0032-keep_both_match_task have identical reported validation metrics at the same seed. These are bridge observations, not independent repeated support. No execution failure is reported in the supplied trajectory index; several branches failed to improve quality.

analysis_plan.notation: A_rab is full-population validation click ROC-AUC for routing r in {task,shared}, raw match-action availability a and scaled match-action availability b. 11=both,10=raw,01=scaled,00=none.
analysis_plan.primary_estimand: D_r=A_r11-A_r00; I=D_task-D_shared. Report conditional removal utility and its operational routing interaction.
secondary_estimands: R_r=A_r11-A_r10-A_r01+A_r00; J=R_task-R_shared. Negative R suggests substitutability on the AUC scale, not independent causal redundancy.
Raw effects A_r10-A_r00 and A_r11-A_r01; scaled effects A_r01-A_r00 and A_r11-A_r10. Report every cell and contrast; do not select the most favorable contrast.

For each availability cell report routing contrast A_task,ab-A_shared,ab. Repeat all contrasts for unweighted click Logloss with lower-is-better sign explicit; all four AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately.
analysis_plan.decision_rule: Predeclare |I|>=0.0005 as a practical trigger for paired repetition and scale/gradient controls. For |I|<0.0005 report a small observed interaction only; no equivalence, significance or general no-interaction claim. Negative R and positive D in both routes would motivate testing robustness, not establish a mechanism.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: One seed only in this phase. If authorized host supplies paired validation predictions with cluster identifiers, use the same user-cluster resamples for all eight cells and report 95% paired bootstrap intervals for D,I,R,J (1000 draws, fixed analysis RNG), fully charging cost. User IDs and sample identity must never enter Model.forward. If unavailable, state interval unavailable, do not replace with impression-IID bootstrap or infer significance. Additional seeds require later host authorization; do not edit frozen seed.
analysis_plan.slices: Use existing history bins 0,1-16,17-64,>64. Report samples, positives and negatives and mark single-class/insufficient slices. Other requested hour/composition/frequency/missing slices require authorized host metadata and training-defined or predeclared bins; unavailable diagnostics remain unavailable. Empty-history differences after retraining are an optimization negative control, not evidence of direct feedback use; at common fixed state availability intervention must be inert there.
analysis_plan.measured_cost: Host reports total/embedding/dense parameters, allocated GPU seconds, train/complete wall time, examples processed, peak GPU bytes, inference throughput and batch p50/p95 at batch8192. Same forward bank execution does not guarantee equal backward or wall cost. Compare matched passes here; claim no equal-compute efficiency frontier from this suite.

Exercise empty/singleton/noncontiguous/partial/full histories and repeated actions. Verify target-action and invalid-history perturbation invariance and inherited malformed/missing task-mask rejection behavior. No mask is broadened or reindexed. Check the validity-restricted gather preserves per-block valid action multisets/sums and never crosses a sample/block.

At a common state capture all four bank outputs. The task correction is exactly its label-index member; the shared correction is the mean of those same members. Use a deliberately nonidentical/nonzero bank so this test is informative. Verify all four members execute in both routes. Record residual norms, per-member gradient norms and task losses without changing the optimizer or rescaling gradients.

Validate one shared code path against its task diagnostic override and exact task ancestor: predictions/loss, dense and coalesced sparse gradients including indices/values/None-vs-zero, one unchanged AdamW/Adagrad update, Dice buffers and RNG. Expected routing differences are tested against the declared algebra, never forced equal. For task override the entire update must match the ancestor.

Verify auxiliary scorer/item/action parameter gradients remain blocked while context gradients are allowed in both routes. Shared residual parameters can receive every task loss; this is declared rather than an ownership leak. Zero initial final layers mask some differences, so use nonzero-state checks.

In FP32 check row4 coefficient is a per-history nonnegative norm-scaled and support-gated version of row0; report inactive supports separately without dividing by zero. Bound inherited BF16 deviations. Erasure does not itself change these coefficients. Readout/availability interactions may still reflect scale, gates or optimization rather than distinct information.

If exact task bridges fail, record every failure/cost and keep new shared scores exploratory; fresh matched task controls require a later authorized round. Missing preflight is missing evidence, not a failed scientific mechanism. No automatic duplicate training/test request.
host_preflight.tolerances: Exact equality for source/masks/indices/state shapes and initialized state. Host FP32 common-path tensor allclose rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6; frozen-BF16 common-path tensor allclose rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-3; dense/coalesced sparse gradients and one-step updates use those dtype tolerances and require matching sparse index support plus None/zero status. Record max absolute/relative error and dtype; original same-source override should be bitwise reproducible where the host is deterministic. Do not widen thresholds after outcomes or silently accept failed checks. Tolerances certify implementation comparisons, not statistical performance.
